gold_set: FDA Drug Safety-related Labeling Changes (SrLC), Jul 2021-Jun 2026, mapped to FAERS ingredients and Preferred Terms
status: author-built by automated PT mention match; PENDING FACULTY REVIEW
caveats: Only 20 quarters (2021Q3-2026Q2) are loaded, so lead times are bounded by that window and the first-signal quarter can be left-censored.
Reporting to FAERS often rises after a label change or press coverage (stimulated reporting), which can make a signal appear around the change rather than before it.
FAERS dates are report-receipt dates, not event dates, and a case counts from its latest report version, so the first-signal quarter is conservative (late).
Label changes are not a complete or exclusive list of a drug's true adverse effects, so this measures agreement with FDA labelling, not detection of all real harms.
The label-change reference maps added label text to Preferred Terms automatically and is pending faculty review; a mismatch in that mapping mis-scores a pair.
